subject: Azure Marketplace offer: rendering & legal metadata gap analysis for Contoso SaaS
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Gina Huang <gina@contoso.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Marketplace offer: initial rendering + legal metadata gaps

Hi Gina,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. I pulled together a short technical acceptance checklist after reviewing the sandbox offer you shared and the publisher portal preview. There are three classes of issues blocking our final submission:

1) Offer rendering: when the listing renders in the Publisher preview it strips the top-line feature bullets and truncates the demo video thumbnail. This looks like a manifest -> UI mapping problem (we suspect an unexpected key under "marketplaceDisplay" in the offer JSON).

2) Entitlements mapping: the SaaS fulfillment callback is returning a "SubscriptionId" that doesn't match the example in the Fulfillment docs — Contoso's test tenant returns a GUID with an extra prefix. We need a reproducible webhook payload so our backend can validate the entitlement flow.

3) Legal/metadata: your publisher profile is missing the subscription-level Data Processing Addendum (DPA) field, and the legal contact email doesn't match the verified publisher identity. Microsoft validation will fail if those two fields are not reconciled before technical validation.

Attached I included a compact manifest-checklist.csv with the fields we think are the source-of-truth mapping, and an example ARM/manifest snippet (arm-template-sample.json) showing how Redwood expects the galleryProperties and plan metadata to be populated.

Next steps I propose:
- Gina: can you export the SaaS fulfillment webhook sample payload for the failing flow and attach it here?
- Contoso partner ops: please confirm the publisher ID used in the portal and the legal contact email (it should match the verified account).
- Karthik/Marissa: once we have the webhook payload we'll run an integration test against our staging Fulfillment endpoint (staging.redwood.ai/marketplace/fulfill).

If we get those artifacts by COB Wed (US-PST) we should be able to move to validation-ready and request an expedited technical gate review.

Thanks,

--
Olga Petrov
Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
[attachment: manifest-checklist.csv (text/csv)]
[attachment: arm-template-sample.json (application/json)]

From: Gina Huang <gina@contoso.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Contoso Partner Ops <contoso-partner-team@contoso.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace offer: initial rendering + legal metadata gaps

Hi Olga — appreciate the detailed list. Quick responses inline: 

1) Rendering: that was a manual edit from an earlier marketing pass; we accidentally used the legacy "summaryBullets" key. We'll swap to "marketplaceDisplay.bullets" and push a new version to the preview. I'll confirm once the preview refreshes.

2) Fulfillment webhook: attaching a sample payload from our sandbox flow (you'll see the SubscriptionId has the "contoso-" prefix; we can remove it to match the documented GUID format).

3) Legal: our publisher identity is verified under publisher@contoso.com, but the person on the account is still listed as partner-ops@contoso.com in the portal. Partner ops will follow up with Microsoft to align the contact email and upload the DPA.

I'll include work estimates for each fix in a brief update by tomorrow.

Best,
Gina
Director, Product Partnerships — Contoso
[attachment: contoso-fulfillment-sample.json (application/json)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Azure Marketplace offer: initial rendering + legal metadata gaps

Thanks — I took the sample webhook Gina attached and ran it against our staging fulfillment endpoint. Results: 1) our parser fails on the "contoso-" prefix but converges with a simple regex; 2) the plan mapping fails when the planId in the webhook is numeric-only — Contoso is sending a plan index ("1") instead of the canonical plan GUID.

Action items for us:
- I will extend the parser to accept the prefix for a short window and add a warning in our logs to surface to customers.
- We should ask Contoso to produce a webhook with the canonical plan GUID and run a second test.

Also noticed in the ARM sample that the galleryProperties.logoUri is hosted on a private blob with referrer restrictions; Microsoft preview will not be able to fetch it. Gina, can you either host the asset in a public blob container or add a shared access signature for the validation step?

I'll prepare a short runbook with the steps we used and share it here so Contoso can repeat validation on demand.

-Karthik
Lead Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: runbook-staging-integration.md (text/markdown)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Gina Huang <gina@contoso.com>, Contoso Partner Ops <contoso-partner-team@contoso.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Azure Marketplace Support <mpn-support@microsoft.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace offer: initial rendering + legal metadata gaps — plan to remediation and timeline

Gina / Contoso team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Summary and our proposed timeline to keep the offer in the current validation window: 

1) Contoso: publish a preview update that uses "marketplaceDisplay.bullets" and exposes the demo thumbnail via a public SAS link (or public container). Target: Thu EOD.
2) Contoso: provide a second webhook payload with canonical SubscriptionId and plan GUID. Target: Thu EOD.
3) Contoso: reconcile publisher contact > ensure the DPA and legal contact email are present in the portal and match verified identity. Target: Fri midday.

Once the two technical artifacts (preview update + webhook) are delivered we'll run a fast validation exercise from our side (Karthik to execute) and attach the validation logs to your HubSpot record so you have an audit trail for Microsoft. I'll also loop in Azure Support to request a short hold on the manual gate if needed.

Attached: contoso-legal-edu.pdf (notes we provided to partners about legal metadata requirements) and the manifest checklist.

If this schedule looks good I'll convert these actions into a short mutual action plan and create a DocuSign for the co-sell opt-in.

Regards,

--
Olga Petrov
Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
[attachment: contoso-legal-edu.pdf (application/pdf)]
